description.value: You add the burst force power to your repertoire without it counting against your number of powers known. When you cast it as your action, you may apply your Double Strike Force-Empowered Self option to it, though if the power would affect several creatures, only a single target suffers the extra damage. You also add your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (whichever you prefer, minimum +1) to its damage rolls, and any creature that succeeds on its saving throw takes half damage rather than none.
